title: The Bee's Knees | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: The Bee's Knees is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Looking for a spacious getaway just steps from Seagrove Beach? The Bee's Knees is a five-bedroom, four-bathroom retreat designed for memorable gatherings with family and friends. Nestled in a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers both privacy and convenience, sitting right next to the community pool and comfortably accommodating up to 14 guests. You can also enjoy full access to the community tennis and pickleball courts, perfect for a bit of friendly competition during your stay.From the moment you arrive, you'll have everything you need for a seamless beachside stay. Six complimentary bikes make it easy to explore the area, whether you're cruising along 30A or discovering hidden local gems. After a day in the sand, rinse off in the outdoor shower before unwinding in the bright and airy living area on the second floor. A plush sofa and large TV set the stage for cozy movie nights, while the fireplace adds warmth on cooler evenings. The fully equipped kitchen features a standard coffee maker, Keurig, toaster, and a refrigerator with an ice maker, making it easy to prepare meals and snacks. Gather around the dining table with seating for seven, or enjoy casual bites at the kitchen island with three barstools. An adjacent table with four chairs provides additional seating for meals or games. Start your mornings on the spacious porch with a fresh cup of coffee, taking in the coastal air as you plan the day's adventures. A washer and dryer on the first floor add to the convenience, ensuring you’re always ready for your next outing.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor:Bedroom 1: King Bed, TV, Shared Bathroom with Walk-in ShowerBedroom 2: Queen Bed, TV, Shared Bathroom with Walk-in ShowerBedroom 3: Two Twin XL-over-Queen Bunk Beds, TV, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo2nd Floor:Bunk Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Walk-in Shower3rd Floor:Bedroom 4: Master King Bed, TV, Private Balcony, Shared Bathroom with Walk-in ShowerBedroom 5: Full Bed, TV, Shared Bathroom with Walk-in ShowerMake the most of the home's outdoor features, from scenic bike rides to sun-soaked beach days. Explore the area on two wheels, whether you're cruising along 30A or discovering local gems. When you're ready for the beach, it's just steps from your door, perfect for sunbathing, shell collecting, or enjoying the Gulf’s turquoise waters. To make your beach days even easier, the garage is stocked with essentials, including folding wagons, 12 beach chairs, 5 umbrellas, an inflatable mattress, a beach mat, and buckets and toys for the little ones.After a day in the sun, rinse off at the outdoor shower and fire up the grill right next to it for a relaxed cookout. The community pool next door offers a refreshing break. Guests will also have full access to the tennis court, which is directly next to the pool and equipped with two pickleball courts and nets—perfect for friendly competition or staying active on vacation. Cruise around effortlessly with the six-passenger golf cart, making it easy to explore nearby attractions.When it’s time to venture out, you're surrounded by some of the best dining and shopping on 30A. Savor locally inspired flavors at Café 30A, Seagrove Market, Surfing Deer, and The Perfect Pig, or enjoy the lively atmosphere at The Big Chill and Old Florida Fish House. The charming streets of Seaside and WaterColor offer boutique shopping, live entertainment, and views that make every visit unforgettable. Whether you're indulging in fresh seafood, discovering artisan finds, or taking a sunset stroll along the coast, every moment here feels like a true 30A experience.Your stay at The Bee's Knees comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Snowbird Friendly!* Sorry, no pets are allowed.* Parking for 3 cars.
